scripts.lint: npm --prefix venkys run lint && npm --prefix venkys_admin run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix venkys run build && npm --prefix venkys_admin run build
scripts.check-rules: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const r1 = fs.readFileSync('venkys/firestore.rules', 'utf8'); const r2 = fs.readFileSync('venkys_admin/firestore.rules', 'utf8'); if (r1 !== r2) { console.error('ERROR: firestore.rules mismatch between venkys and venkys_admin'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('OK: firestore.rules synchronized'); }"
